\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.PathHardDecide}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Query language]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.qLang}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.qLang}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.PathHard.red, Complexity.indexLang}
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $c_0$ be a
natural number, and let $b$ be a Boolean. For each Boolean string $x$, let $r(x)$ be the
reduction output. If $b$ is true, the language contains exactly the indexed pairs
$(x,i)$ with $i<|r(x)|$; if $b$ is false, it contains exactly the pairs $(x,i)$ for
which the $i$th entry of $r(x)$ is true, taking an out-of-range entry to be false.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Query length bound]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.qBnd}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.qBnd}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.PathHard.nV}
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $c_0$ be a
natural number, and let $y$ be a finite Boolean string. Define the bound
$B(y)=|y|+8V(K,c_0,|y|)^2+8$, where $K$ is the code parameter of $N$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Lower bound on the code width]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.c₀_le}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK}
\difficulty{2}
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work
tapes and a finite state set $Q$. Set $h=3(|Q|+1)$ and $K=2(h+3k+1)+2$. For every
natural number $c_0$, one has $c_0\le K(c_0+1)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Undecodable strings are not indexed]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.not_mem_indexLang_of_pairDecode}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.not_mem_indexLang_of_pairDecode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.indexLang, Turing.pairDecode, Turing.pairDecode_pairEncode}
\difficulty{4}
Let $p$ be any predicate on bit strings and nonnegative integers, and let $y$ be a bit
string for which the aligned pair parser fails. Then $y$ does not belong to the language
consisting of encodings of pairs $(x,\operatorname{bits}(i))$ such that $p(x,i)$ holds.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Agreement with the Language Indicator]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.wAns_eq}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.wAns_eq}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.PathHard.ell, Complexity.PathHard.length_red, Complexity.PathHard.nV, Complexity.PathHard.qLang, Complexity.PathHard.red_getD, Complexity.PathHard.wAns, Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{5}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, let $c_0$ be a
natural number, let $x$ be a bit string, let $i$ be a natural number, and let
$\mathrm{mode}$ be a Boolean. The Boolean value
$\mathrm{wAns}(N,x,\mathrm{mode},c_0\ell(|x|),[K(c_0+1)+K+2]\ell(|x|))$, where $K$ is
the code-width parameter of $N$, equals the indicator of membership of the paired
encoding of $x$ and the binary expansion of $i$ in the indexed language
$qLang(N,c_0,\mathrm{mode})$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Halting of the query algorithm]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.query_halts}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.query_halts}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.bitsVal_le_of_width, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.Codec.pairEncode_inj, Complexity.LogProg.AHalt, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.halt, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.trans, Complexity.LogProg.GuardLe, Complexity.LogProg.bitsVal, Complexity.LogProg.canon_bits, Complexity.LogProg.canon_eq_bits, Complexity.LogProg.indicator_eq_decide, Complexity.LogProg.length_bits_mono, Complexity.PathHard.A, Complexity.PathHard.St.Bd, Complexity.PathHard.St.toV_zero, Complexity.PathHard.cdec_false, Complexity.PathHard.check_decode_run, Complexity.PathHard.c₀_le, Complexity.PathHard.ell, Complexity.PathHard.ell_mono, Complexity.PathHard.four_le_nV, Complexity.PathHard.length_red, Complexity.PathHard.nV, Complexity.PathHard.nV_mono, Complexity.PathHard.not_mem_indexLang_of_pairDecode, Complexity.PathHard.orc, Complexity.PathHard.parse_run, Complexity.PathHard.qBnd, Complexity.PathHard.qLang, Complexity.PathHard.red, Complexity.PathHard.setSt, Complexity.PathHard.setup_run, Complexity.PathHard.wAns, Complexity.PathHard.wAns_eq, Complexity.PathHard.walk_halt, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode, Turing.length_pairEncode, Turing.pairDecode, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{7}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let
$c_0$ be a natural number, let $y$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $mode$ be a
Boolean. The register program with parameters $a=codeK(N)(c_0+1)$ and $b=codeK(N)+2$,
using the oracle that decides the five languages specified for $N$, halts from its
initial state with all fifteen registers zero and no answer recorded, and its answer is
membership of $y$ in the query language for $N,c_0,$ and $mode$. At every configuration
before halting, the program satisfies its guard: its preconditions hold and every
register is at most $|y|+8nV(codeK(N),c_0,|y|^2)+8$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Polynomial Bound on the Query Bound]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.qBnd_le}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.qBnd_le}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.PathHard.nV, Complexity.PathHard.nV_le, Complexity.PathHard.qBnd}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $c_0$
be a natural number, and let $y$ be a bit string. With $K$ the code-width parameter of
$N$, define $\ell(m)=|\operatorname{bits}(m+1)|$, $E=K(c_0+1)\ell(|y|^2)+(K+2)$, and
$V=2^E$. Then
\[
|y|+8V|y|^2+8\le \bigl(8(2^{K+2}2^{K(c_0+1)})^2+9\bigr)(|y|+1)^{2K(c_0+1)+1}.
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Logspace computability of the reduction]
\lean{Complexity.PathHard.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_red}
\label{Complexity.PathHard.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_red}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable, Complexity.LOGSPACE, Complexity.LogProg.AHalt.mono, Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_poly, Complexity.PathHard.A, Complexity.PathHard.As, Complexity.PathHard.As_mem, Complexity.PathHard.length_red_le, Complexity.PathHard.qBnd_le, Complexity.PathHard.qLang, Complexity.PathHard.query_halts, Complexity.PathHard.red}
\difficulty{4}
For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and every
natural number $c_0$, the reduction output has length bounded by $C(|x|+1)^c$ for some
natural numbers $C,c$ and every input bit string $x$. Moreover, both languages of
indexed output bits and output positions—whose membership predicates respectively ask
whether the bit at position $i$ is true and whether $i$ is less than the output
length—are decidable in logarithmic space.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[NL-hardness of the raw path language]
\lean{Complexity.pathRawLang_NLHard}
\label{Complexity.pathRawLang_NLHard}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NL, Complexity.PathHard.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_red, Complexity.PathHard.red, Complexity.PathHard.red_mem_iff, Complexity.pathRawLang}
\difficulty{4}
Let $L$ be a language of binary strings in nondeterministic logarithmic space. Then $L$
has a logspace many-one reduction to the raw path language: there is a
logspace-computable map sending a string $x$ to a string in the raw path language
exactly when $x\in L$.
\end{theorem}
